versions.changelog:
palace-diagram 1.0.0

- Initial release providing Mermaid and ASCII diagrams of memory palaces
- Visualizes palace structure, entity relationships, and synapse connectivity/strength
- Offers multiple diagram types: palace map, entity graph, synapse heatmap, and ASCII overview
- Not yet integrated with commands or agents—manual script usage required
- Compatible with related memory-palace tools for generating and displaying visualizations
